test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CRAFT' is coded as 'DSBGU' and ‘FRIDAY' is coded as 'GSJEBZ’. What is the code for 'MANGO' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'CRAFT' is coded as 'DSBGU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cdec655cf185a0103b7690be120f6ef8144f204c751e178397014a695f1c684.png] 

And, 

 
• ‘FRIDAY' is coded as 'GSJEBZ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e90a40d0bc8588eefec3167b43d7b8ee25b84c56fc26fa820229c9494bcd4876.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'MANGO' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8412347d2b98b0553ff24bb0292fb1f1d522df7d2f9fad521af8361ed68ab43.png] 

Hence, "**NBOHP**" is the correct answer.
